title: stop hook re-fires while a reviewer agent is still running
detail: During reviewing, the main thread hands work to a background reviewer agent and ends its turn. The Stop hook ('Phase reviewing has unsatisfied exit artifacts: regression.txt verdict must be PASS') blocks the stop. That forces another main-thread turn, which can do nothing but say it is waiting, and each such turn re-reads the whole session context. In the one-bash-lexer session this fired 6 times while the reviewer, the token sweep and the fuzz ran; trivial-lane sprints spend about 2M of 4-6M total in the reviewing phase. Candidate: Stop does not block while a background reviewer or a capture for the current feature is in flight, or blocks once per artifact state rather than on every stop.
